---
format: 
  pdf:
    documentclass: report
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    mainfont: "TeX Gyre Termes"
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{adjustbox}
        \usepackage{enumitem}
        \setlist[itemize]{label=$\bullet$}
        \usepackage{titlesec}
        \usepackage{xcolor}
        \usepackage{parskip}
        \usepackage{float}
        \floatplacement{figure}{H}
        \floatplacement{table}{H}
        \usepackage{indentfirst}
        % -----------------------------------------------
        % Couleurs
        % -----------------------------------------------
        \definecolor{couleurPartie}{RGB}{0, 0, 0}
        \definecolor{couleurSousPartie}{RGB}{0, 0, 0}
        \definecolor{couleurSSPartie}{RGB}{0, 0, 0}
        \definecolor{couleurSpecial}{RGB}{0, 0, 0}
        % -----------------------------------------------
        % Sections
        % -----------------------------------------------
        \titleformat{\section}
          {\fontsize{14}{18}\selectfont\bfseries\color{couleurPartie}}
          {\thesection}{1em}{}
        \titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{12pt}{4pt}
        \titleformat{\subsection}
          {\fontsize{12}{15}\selectfont\bfseries\color{couleurSousPartie}}
          {\thesubsection}{1em}{}
        \titlespacing{\subsection}{0pt}{10pt}{3pt}
        \titleformat{\subsubsection}
          {\fontsize{11}{14}\selectfont\bfseries\color{couleurSSPartie}}
          {\thesubsubsection}{1em}{}
        \titlespacing{\subsubsection}{0pt}{8pt}{2pt}
        % -----------------------------------------------
        % Sections non numérotées
        % -----------------------------------------------
        \titleformat{name=\section, numberless}
          {\fontsize{16}{20}\selectfont\bfseries\color{couleurSpecial}}
          {}{0em}{}
        \titlespacing{name=\section, numberless}{0pt}{12pt}{4pt}
        % -----------------------------------------------
        % Paragraphes
        % -----------------------------------------------
        \setlength{\parindent}{1.5em}
        \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
lang: fr
fontsize: 12pt
papersize: a4
geometry: top=1.5cm, bottom=1.5cm, left=2.5cm, right=2.5cm
link-citations: true 
nocite: "@*"
editor: 
  markdown: 
    wrap: sentence
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
